items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: And now some guys like Foster, you know, they would get a brass band.

ctx.x: They always wanted to play them dodges. Oh, yeah.

Yeah. And now some guys like Foster, you know, they would get a brass band. Maybe he might know some people uptown got a club or borrow them or something, they're picking up some money, you know, to get a band, you know, like the Caledonia do, you know, see. Well they would pick up anybody and go ahead and play the funeral, you know, play them funeral marches by head, you know, lead me savior, narrow my God to thee, you know, and that was it. That was all. You see they could play. But when it comes down to real,…
Kind of skipping around a little bit. Did you ever work at Pete Lawrence? Yeah, I worked at Pete Lawrence.
